text:
Several cells are connected in series, as shown.
What is the combined electromotive force (e.m.f.) of the cells?
A
the average of the e.m.f.s of the separate cells
B
the e.m.f. of one of the cells
C
the product of the e.m.f.s of the cells
D
the sum of the e.m.f.s of the cells

options.label: A
